Q: Looking for an idea for a project to work on while studying programming A:

You can try creating a simple face authenticated attendance system with that raspberry pi and a simple camera module.

Q: How to key a floating-point (double) value in a std::map? A:

Perhaps you can store the original key in the value part so the layer above can still access the original figure? I feel at some point you're going to have to bite the bullet and make the change. Put as many original behaviour tests in place as possible to make sure the operation after the change matches before.

Q: AttributeError: module 'pyqtgraph.Qt.QtGui' has no attribute 'QApplication'." A:

GraphicsWindow has been deprecated, you should replace it with GraphicsLayoutWidget.

Q: How to change fill color for React icons? A:

just add classname to your icon like

  1. <AiFillHeart classname="w-8 h-8 text-primary"/> instead of primary you can choose other various color of tailwindcss. if you are using tailwind css, or you can also add bootstrap classes above is your required answer.

  2. <AiFillHeart classname="icon"/> now you can style with more traditional way by using css file.

  3. <AiFillHeart style="" width={10px} height={10px}/>

Q: Failed to execute goal org.codehaus.mojo:exec-maven-plugin:1.3.2:exec (default) on project mavenproject2: A:

Allow Netbeans to index the maven repository at

~\.m2\repository\org\codehaus\mojo

after the repository gets indexed everything should work fine.
